name: Cabo San Lucas

queries.query: Cabo San Lucas Mexico official cadastral map parcel viewer catastro Los Cabos
queries.result: Official discovery found the Catastro Los Cabos portal, its cartography pages, and the municipal treasury's Dirección Municipal de Catastro. The portal advertises online cadastral cartography, but no anonymous parcel feature response or public service endpoint was verified.

queries.query: Cabo San Lucas México catastro visor catastral mapa predios oficial municipio Los Cabos
queries.result: La búsqueda oficial/local identificó a la Dirección Municipal de Catastro del Ayuntamiento de Los Cabos como custodio catastral municipal. Las páginas oficiales describen cartografía catastral, padrón gráfico/cartográfico y la herramienta CartoData, pero no se verificó una respuesta anónima acotada con identidad nativa y geometría parcelaria.

researchNote: The municipal cadastral custodian and its city/municipality cartographic mandate are evidenced. The advertised online cartography was not usable as a verified open parcel feature service in this attempt: direct HTTPS retrieval failed certificate verification because the host certificate was expired, and no TLS exception was authorized. No claim of citywide absence is made.
